crossRefs.note: But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you.
Then you shall return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him who serves God and him who doesn’t…
surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.

translations.web: Please return. Let there be no injustice. Yes, return again. My cause is righteous.
translations.bsb: Reconsider; do not be unjust. Reconsider, for my righteousness is at stake.
translations.kjv: Return, I pray you, let it not be iniquity; yea, return again, my righteousness
translations.asv: Return, I pray you, let there be no injustice; Yea, return again, my cause is righteous.
